system.description:
Your instincts predispose you to a certain approach to battle. When you become a warrior, choose one permanent benefit from the following list. When you retrain at the haven, you may change it.

  • Aggression: You gain +2 initiative.

  • Flexibility: You gain +2 prevail.

  • Survival: You gain +2 tenacity.

  • Willpower: You gain +2 resist.
